items.question: Which further female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate female figures who know through devotion on earth.
This verse adds ulukī and pecakī as further figures in that enumeration.
This verse also adds sararī and gūlī likewise to the same group.
items.inference: The owl-woman, peacock-woman, sararī-woman, and gūlī-woman are likewise included among those who know through devotion on earth.
uncertainties: The precise identities or symbolic meanings of sararī and gūlī are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sararī-woman, or the gūlī-woman likewise.
